models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered user table for the Todo List application. 

Represents all end users who register, authenticate, and manage their personal todos. Each user record contains essential authentication fields (unique email, securely hashed password) and all metadata for identity lifecycle events such as registration, email verification, password reset tokens, and account status flags.

This model enforces unique email addresses, secure credential policy, and account isolation for each user. It provides necessary fields for business processes including registration, password reset, email confirmation, locked/active status, and full account deletion lifecycle. The table is primary for independent user management, supports full CRUD, and underpins all authentication and authorization logic.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address, used as the primary login credential. Must be unique and conform to email format standards. Required for registration and login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the user's password. Never stores plaintext. Only hash output is allowed (e.g., bcrypt, argon2).

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the user's email has been successfully verified. True when verification process completed.

plainFields.name: email_verification_token
plainFields.description: One-time token used to confirm user email verification. Null if already verified or immediately after verification.

plainFields.name: email_verification_sent_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when the last verification email was sent to the user. Null if never sent or already verified.

plainFields.name: reset_password_token
plainFields.description: Unique token used for user-initiated password resets. Null if not in reset flow.

plainFields.name: reset_password_sent_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of when the most recent password reset token was issued (UTC). Used for computing expiration.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the account has been temporarily locked due to repeated failed login attempts or security actions. Used to prevent login until reset.

plainFields.name: locked_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when user account was locked due to authentication failures or administrative actions. Null if not currently locked.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when user was deleted (account removal). Null if active. Used to ensure full cleanup, may drive future delayed deletion policy.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Session and login audit table for registered users. 

Each session represents an authenticated login instance, storing connection context metadata, linkage to user identity, and tracking for active/expired sessions. Enforces auditing and session lifecycle management required for compliance, security reviews, and JWT/session revocation at logout, password reset, or account deletion.

Sessions may support persistent user tokens, device metadata, and are strictly subsidiary—created and managed through user login and logout flows. This model does not allow independent CRUD. Essential for monitoring login activity and enforcing proper security policies.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Linked user for this session. Foreign key to {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session/login was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL or endpoint used at login/session creation. Used for audit and debugging.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at session creation. May be empty but is required for full traceability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Datetime marking when the session expired or was revoked. Null if session is currently active.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
User-specific todo item entity for personal task management.

Each row represents a single actionable task belonging to exactly one authenticated user, supporting core CRUD operations and completion toggling. The table enforces strict single-user ownership through a foreign key to {@link todo_list_users}, ensuring all todos are fully partitioned by owner—no task is ever shared or visible between users. Each todo must have a non-empty title (max 100 chars) unique within the scope of its user, and may contain an optional description (max 1000 chars). The entity tracks creation, last update, and (if completed) completion timestamps for full auditability of changes, following business rules for hard (irreversible) deletion. Status field enables differentiating between incomplete and complete tasks for filtered queries. No subsidiary, snapshot, or cross-user relationships exist by design. All access and data changes are strictly scoped to the authenticated task owner.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies the todo item within the system.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign Key. Refers to the owner user account. Enforces strict single-user ownership. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Required; must be unique per user and limited to 100 Unicode characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional free-text description (up to 1000 characters) providing additional context for the task. If present, cannot exceed length constraint.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the todo item: valid values are 'incomplete' and 'complete'. Dictates the business state for completion queries and toggling.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp representing when the item was marked complete. Null if the task is currently incomplete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp set when the todo is first inserted. Used for default ordering and auditing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update. Updated on every content or status change for robust change traceability.
